title: Citation, version 1
description: The document of a CITATION statement: the artist of a work cites another work by chain ID, contract and token ID. A claim by the citing artist; the cited work's artist does not consent. Rules: docs/spec/declarations-and-conventions.md (DCL-18).

subject.description: The citing work: the statement's own subject.

citedContentHash.description: What the cited token showed when cited, if known.
